notes.title: 🚀 Iridio is LIVE in Early Access on Steam! 🎮🔥
notes.content:
[p]Hello folks, the wait is finally over!

🚀 Iridio is LIVE in Early Access on Steam! 🎮🔥

This is just the beginning of the journey, and we would love for you to be part of it. 
By jumping in now, you’re not just playing: you’re helping shape the future of Iridio. 
[/p][p]Every bit of feedback, every idea, and every bug you find will make the game better, stronger, and more fun for everyone. 💡🛠️

Your support means the world 💚🤍, and together we can build something truly amazing. So grab your gear, dive into the adventure, and let’s write the story of Iridio together! 🌍⚡

KR Games team[/p]

notes.title: 10 DAYS TO GO!
notes.content:
[p][b]10 DAYS TO GO![/b][/p][p]The wait is almost over, and we couldn’t have made it this far without your support 🤍💚[/p][p][b]Iridio[/b] is nearly ready for its [i]Early Access[/i] launch: the adventure is fully playable, though still evolving, and your feedback will be key in shaping its future.[/p][p]Get ready to step into a world where strategy, shooting, and survival collide. 
Together, we’ll make [i]Iridio[/i] the best it can be.[/p][p]The countdown begins NOW! 🚀[/p]

notes.title: Early Access release date is August 29th
notes.content:
🚀[b] Hey Iridio fans! Quick update on our Early Access launch![/b] 💫

We’ve got some news: our Early Access release on Steam is going to be postponed just a little bit. Why? Because Iridio is still a work in progress, and we want to give you the best possible experience when it finally lands in your hands. 🎮✨

New EA release date is:  [b]August 29th 2025[/b]

We're currently deep in refining, tweaking, fixing, testing. 
This extra summer time will help us make Iridio smoother, more fun, and more worthy of the awesome community that’s been cheering us on. 🙌

Thanks so much for your patience and your support! It really keeps us going. 💚🤍

Stay tuned for more updates coming!

KR Games team

notes.title: Iridio will release in Q2 2025!
notes.content:
Hello, Iridio fans!

We have a quick update to share on the release timeline for Iridio. 

To ensure a smooth and polished experience, we’re moving the Early Access launch for Iridio, which will now take place in [b]Q2 2025[/b], with the full game targeted for an [b]April/May[/b] release.

We appreciate your ongoing support and patience as we work to make Iridio the best experience possible. 

[b]Thank you[/b] for being on this journey with us! 💚🤍

KR Games Team
